PURCHASE CLOSEOUT
Bought 12 LED downlights at PHP 650 each from BrightHome. Bought 4 emergency lights at PHP 1,250 each from the same supplier; these were separately priced lines.

BrightHome also supplied one discounted lot containing 3 exit signs and 2 battery packs for a source-stated total of PHP 9,500. The component schedule says 3 × 2,000 plus 2 × 1,800, but the signed lot total controls. Discount explanation: negotiated closeout discount. All items available immediately.

human_approval.rationale: Separate attribution, deterministic totals, and source-total package override draft awaiting human review.
